handoff.summary: SUMMARY: Keep J01/J02/J09 unchanged: retention >=4 at ticks 3-6, complete retainer removal by 10, one operator and one action per tick, no mixed retainers or outside resources. Carry exactly C: (0,install,C),(7,remove,C); SV: (0,detach,H),(1,install,V),(2,insert,S,V),(7,withdraw,S,V),(8,remove,V); Q: (0,install,Q),(1,measure,Q),(7,remove,Q). The action arg for both stem operations is the single string S,V. Received model replay makes C and SV feasible at capacity 4, removal boundaries 8/9, costs 2/5 actions, zero impacts. Preserve their tie on mandatory function and clip burden advantage without inventing a required winner. Q returns measurement 4 and hold 4 but status unknown: conditional success is supported in that synthetic branch; theta=0 still defeats a general guarantee. Correct the proposal/replay mismatch without erasing uncertainty. Optional tapping and mechanism choice are available variables; removing required retention, transferring ownership or assuming theta has no opening. Refuse novelty as superiority, empirical physics, canonical-executor claims and invented fallback. Reopen only with changed constraints or supported elimination evidence.
